nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<actress> is a young woman (s1) with wavy brunette hair, whose appearance comes from <Picture 1>.
<scene> is high school classroom, students fills the seats, whose appearance comes from <Picture 2>.
<outfit> is gray long sleeve and dark blue jeans, whose appearance comes from <Picture 3>.

summary:
[reference generation] target video shows a woman delivering an emotional monologue

retention_analysis:
<actress> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - her face, long black hair and build are retained.

<scene> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the classroom and seated students are retained.

<outfit> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the gray long sleeve and dark blue jeans are retained.

detailed_description:
Cinematic shot, shallow depth of field. <actress> wearing <outfit> stands at her seat in the high school classroom from <scene>, holding a single sheet of notebook paper in both hands, students blurred at desks around her. She faces the viewer, line of sight to front left, toward a boy seated out of frame.
[Shot 1] reference <scene>, daytime,

medium shot

<actress> wearing <outfit> is standing at her seat in a high school classroom.

She is facing viewer, line of sight to front left, focusing on a boy seated out of frame.

Guarded and dry at first, reading flatly from the page, trying to sound like she doesn't care.  Her face is full of emotional micro expressions

(s1), a young woman with a General American accent and a low, clear voice:
<d>[English] I hate it when you lie</d>

She glances up from the paper at him, then quickly back down.

<d>[English] I hate it when you make me laugh</d>

Her voice catches on the last word.  Her eyes start to fill.  She stops, swallows, and presses her lips together.

Camera pushes in slowly [Shot 2] At 00:10.0, the camera cuts to Medium close-up, the camera still pushing in slowly. She is on the verge of tears, eyes wet, chin trembling, the paper held in both hands.

(s1), a young woman with a General American accent and a low voice on the verge of tears:

<d>[English] Even worse when you make me cry</d>

She blinks hard.  A tear runs down her cheek.  She pulls in a shaky breath through her nose.


<d>[English] I hate it when you're not around</d>

Her chin trembles.  She looks down at the paper as if she has lost her place.


<d>[English] And the fact that you didn't call</d>

She pauses for a long beat.  She lowers the paper slightly and looks straight at him, eyes wet.

Camera pushes in slowly [Shot 3] At 00:20.0, the camera cuts to close-up, the camera still pushing in slowly. She is already crying, eyes wet, chin trembling, the paper lowered slightly.

(s1), a young woman with a General American accent and a low voice now thick with tears:

<d>[English] But mostly I- </d>

Her voice breaks.  She inhales.

<d>[English] -hate the way I don't hate you </d>

The camera settles into a tight close-up of her face and holds

she pauses,
she shakes her head slightly

<d>[English] Not even close</d>

<d>[English] Not even a little bit</d>

Her voice is barely above a whisper, crying openly now.

<d>[English] Not even at all</d>

She lowers the paper completely and holds his gaze, tears streaming.  She then looks right and down and walks quickly to scene right towards the door.  Tracking shot as she walks, the camera stops as she exits the frame completely

overall_soundscape:
Quiet classroom room tone. Paper rustling in her hands, soft sniffles and unsteady breaths.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
